control_plane_mh.label: Spirent RT-1/RT-4 Control Plane Simulation (available NOW)
control_plane_mh.description: Spirent BGP peer injects EVPN RT-1 (Ethernet Auto-Discovery per-EVI and per-ES) and RT-4 (ES route) to simulate a remote PE in the same Ethernet Segment. Tests DF election, mass-withdraw, split-horizon filtering on PE-1.
spirent_steps: 2. Spirent BGP peer injects RT-4 (ES route) with SAME ESI -> PE-1 thinks remote PE shares segment
3. PE-1 runs DF election. Verify: show evpn instance {evpn_name} ethernet-segments-info
4. Spirent injects RT-1 per-ES (AD per-ES) -> mass-withdraw test: withdraw RT-4 and check PE-1 withdraws all MACs
5. Spirent injects RT-1 per-EVI (AD per-EVI) -> aliasing test: verify PE-1 considers remote PE for load balancing

trigger_functions.withdraw: spirent_withdraw by protocol-stop or explicit withdraw

data_plane_mh_via_dnaas.label: DNAAS Dual-PE Data Plane (requires PE-4 or equivalent)
data_plane_mh_via_dnaas.description: Real dual-homed topology via DNAAS. Spirent port on B-14 reaches both PE-1 and PE-2 through different DNAAS BD paths.
requirements: PE-4 (or equivalent) available with EVPN instance and same ESI as PE-1
DNAAS BD from B-14 to PE-4's leaf (need to identify PE-4's leaf from LLDP)
VPLS peering between PE-1 and PE-4
Spirent sends L2 traffic to both PEs through different outer VLANs

dnaas_path.pe1: B-14 -> fabric -> D-16 -> PE-1 (existing, fabric VLAN 214)
dnaas_path.note: Each PE gets traffic on a different DNAAS BD. Same inner MAC on both paths.

data_plane_mh_via_dnaas.what_it_tests: Everything including actual dual-homed data-plane forwarding
